xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3233: Enrichment classification defects hide genuinely frozen agents: specialist suppression zeroes the work agent's permission prompt, user_question yields empty kinds (35 agents invisible + unreapable), count semantics exclude pane prompts

plan.title: Enrichment classification defects hide genuinely frozen agents (suppression, empty kinds, count semantics)
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: Three verified defects in src/lib/agent-enrichment.ts hide genuinely frozen agents: (1) specialist suppression zeroes a work agent's live tool-permission pane prompt while review/test runs, with an ungated pendingQuestionReason producing a contradictory fingerprint; (2) user_question/confirmation/disambiguation/planning_done detections yield empty pendingInputKinds, making 35 live agents invisible to the Decisions surface (kinds.length > 0 gate at store.ts:467) and unreapable (pendingInputCount > 0 gate in agent-enrichment-service.ts); (3) pendingQuestionCount counts only JSONL AskUserQuestion entries, so pane prompts always report count 0 against hasPendingQuestion true.
narratives.Proposal: Narrow, decision-complete fixes in the enrichment layer per the PRD (drafts/pan-3233.md): exempt blocking pane detections from specialist suppression; gate the whole question fingerprint (count/prompt/reason) on suppression; add a new 'paneQuestion' kind for question-family detections with an askUserQuestion guard; fold blocking detections into pendingQuestionCount (JSONL length, else 1, 0 when suppressed); add the frontend label; lock Decisions and reap eligibility with regression tests; document kind/suppression/count semantics in docs/PENDING-INPUT.md. The 35 stuck agents self-heal via the 10s enrichment poller after deploy; stopped agents are already cleared by projectPendingInput.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No renaming of pendingQuestionCount (fold chosen; contracts/reducers/frontend untouched by a rename)
- No changes to packages/contracts schemas (kinds are plain strings there)
- No new reconciliation/backfill machinery for the 35 stuck agents (poller re-enrichment + existing projectPendingInput cover it)
- No promotion of 'other'-reason detections into kinds/count (PAN-1591 phantom-row rule preserved)
- No changes to conversation enrichment call sites (they inherit the new kind via shared appendPaneDetectionKind)
- No render-layer fixes (filed separately per the issue)
- No changes to the PAN-3228 recovery gate itself

autoDecisions.summary: Suppression exemption keyed on blocking pane detections only (paneDetection non-null and reason in BLOCKING_AWAITING_INPUT_REASONS).
autoDecisions.rationale: Pane detections are live tmux evidence computed only when JSONL/runtime detections are null, so the exemption cannot expose the stale parked-agent surfaces PAN-1834 suppression exists for; the issue names blocking pane detections (tool_permission foremost) as the mandatory exemption.

autoDecisions.summary: Existing suppression test (compute-agent-enrichment.test.ts:56-72) is rewritten to assert suppression via a JSONL AskUserQuestion instead of a rate_limit pane detection.
autoDecisions.rationale: That test locks the defective behavior the issue mandates removing; rate_limit is a blocking pane reason and must now surface. Suppression itself still needs a lock, so the test is inverted rather than deleted.

autoDecisions.summary: New kind named 'paneQuestion' covering user_question, confirmation, disambiguation, and planning_done detections, guarded against double-representation with askUserQuestion.
autoDecisions.rationale: Symmetric with the existing 'paneChoice' kind; these detections carry no structured payload so reusing 'askUserQuestion' would break payload-expecting consumers; contracts type kinds as plain strings and the frontend label map has a safe fallback, so the addition is purely additive.

autoDecisions.summary: Defect 3 resolved by folding blocking detections into pendingQuestionCount rather than renaming the field.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue offers either option; folding fixes every count > 0 gate in place (audited: pipeline-state.ts hasActualPendingQuestion, getPendingQuestionTitle, listing.ts, event-reducers.ts pass-throughs) while a rename would touch contracts, events, reducers, and frontend for the same observable result.

autoDecisions.summary: The 35 currently-stuck agents are reconciled by the poller, not by new machinery.
autoDecisions.rationale: Active agents re-enrich every 10s and the kinds change emits an enrichment_changed event; stopped agents already have pending fields cleared by projectPendingInput (read-model.ts:267-280). Issue acceptance explicitly allows 'classify correctly after the fix'.

narrative.Action: Per PRD W4, building on fingerprint-consistency: pendingQuestionCount = 0 when suppressed; else pendingQuestions.length when > 0; else 1 when isBlockedOnPendingInput({ hasPendingQuestion, pendingQuestionReason: detection?.reason }) is true; else 0. Tests: pane tool_permission gives count 1; runtime user_question gives count 1; 'other' fallback gives count 0; JSONL questions give count === length. The consumer audit is in the PRD — no consumer changes needed.
